method: Citation-first NFT lifecycle control. Pudgy Penguins is classified only for current operator-documented product, retail, game and brand activity. Operator-reported reach, sign-ups and commercial activity are not treated as independently verified market performance; no floor, volume, holder-retention, royalty-revenue, token-performance, or company-financial conclusion is made.

profile.launched: 2021-07-22 — 8,888 Pudgy Penguins sold out in under 20 minutes at 0.03 ETH each, according to the operator's collection history.
profile.supply: 8,888 unique Pudgy Penguins; this fixed figure applies to the original Ethereum collection, not Lil Pudgys, physical products, PENGU, or later brand extensions.
profile.mint_price: 0.03 ETH per original Pudgy Penguin, operator-reported for the July 2021 mint.
profile.community_history: The operator's own history characterizes the collection as having 'ups and downs' and records 4,444 unique holders in August 2021. That historical holder figure is not used as a current-retention measure.
profile.founder_engagement: A May 2026 operator recap says Pudgy Penguins continued licensing, retail, community and product work, and identifies CEO Luca Netz as hosting an NFT founders roundtable. This is current operating engagement, not a claim about every original founder or company financials.
profile.benefits: Official material describes holder-linked community events, IP-licensing opportunities, and certain ownership-gated experiences. Specific benefits, terms and eligibility change; no perpetual monetary right is asserted.
profile.business: The documented operating model spans an Ethereum NFT collection plus consumer products, retail licensing, browser and mobile games, physical-to-digital toy experiences, community events and social distribution. The causal contribution of any one component is not measured here.
profile.analysis: Classified thriving only because the operator documented active May 2026 licensing, retail, community and product activity after launching Pudgy World in 2026. The browser-game launch report's sign-up and impression figures are operator-reported product telemetry, not an independent revenue, NFT-liquidity or investment-performance result. The dossier deliberately withholds current floor, sales volume, royalty revenue, PENGU value, active-holder retention and company-financial conclusions.
